objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Locally defined or process-related regulations and instructions

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedures describing process sequence and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed steps and procedures for specific work tasks

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-critical information attached to documents

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document component released with main document

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed amendment to existing document without affecting version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request to verify document validity and extend or revoke it

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate previously invalidated document

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: User role with create and edit permissions on document

objs.name: document_reviewer
objs.description: User role verifying technical and formal content correctness

objs.name: document_releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for approving document distribution

objs.name: document_reader
objs.description: User role with read-only access to released documents

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role translating released document content to other languages

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach new document object with selected type and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify document content using office component with TAG technology

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Update document attributes and properties in standardized categories

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Complete workflow step with electronic signature by participant

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal correctness

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve document for publication and distribution to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make released document visible to addressed readers

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose amendment to existing released document

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Create new document version incorporating approved change proposal

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm document validity and extend valid-until date by defined period

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Invalidate document and archive with revoked authorizations

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore previously archived document to valid status

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send notification to users when new document version released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Require users to confirm receipt and understanding of document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User actively confirms acknowledgement of document version

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content to different language
